text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated despite early purchases, so I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than infer a trend from a few months.","Before adding to a holding, I should check how much of my portfolio it represents and avoid letting a few stocks dominate my risk.","I should set a clear plan for monthly contributions and rebalancing, keeping cash for planned purchases instead of making impulsive trades or leaving decisions to drift."]}
